Every red food you eat makes the snake longer and earns 10 points. Hit a wall or the snake's own body and the game is over. The snake speeds up as your score rises
The game area is a 21x21 grid. The snake starts three squares long and grows by one square with each food. It gets a little faster every 50 points, so later in the game you need both speed and smart use of space. Your high score is saved in your browser
Oyun alanının kenarlarında dolaşarak ort: Travel along the edges to keep the middle open. As the snake grows, avoid sudden turns and always leave yourself a way out
Uzun yılanla oynarken alanı sıra sıra ta: With a long snake, sweeping the board row by row works well: go from one edge to the other, shift one square and come back. If the food is behind your body, don't take a shortcut to it; follow the path your tail opens up. Once it speeds up, plan your next two moves ahead

Oyun kutusunun üstündeki \"Macera\" sekm: The "Adventure" tab above the game box opens a 24-level map spread over three worlds. Each level has one goal: eat a set number of food. The level ends the moment you reach it; if you hit a wall, an obstacle, lava or yourself, you retry the level. Finishing gives 1 star, and beating the times shown on screen gives 2 or 3 stars. Getting at least 1 star on a level unlocks the next one
Bahçe dünyasında çitler ve bloklar alanı: In the Garden world, fences and blocks narrow the space. The Cave world has maze walls and tight corridors; in levels 13-16 the edges are open, so a snake leaving one side comes back in on the other. From the Cave onwards special food appears now and then: golden food vanishes after a few seconds but counts as 2 toward the goal, and ice food slows the snake down for 5 seconds. In the Volcano world a new 3-square lava obstacle is added every 5 food. Your stars unlock the Rainbow, Coral, Night and Gold snake skins; skins are only cosmetic and can be used in Classic mode too. Adventure doesn't affect your classic record, the daily challenge or the leaderboard
<strong>Duvardan geçilebilir mi?</strong: Can I go through walls? Not in Classic mode, where hitting a wall ends the game. In Adventure levels 13-16 the edges are open and the snake comes out on the opposite side.
<strong>Macera ilerlemem kaybolur mu?</s: Will I lose my Adventure progress? No. Your stars, unlocked levels and chosen skin are saved in your browser, so you can pick up where you left off.
